name: Park Sun-mi
bio:
Sun-mi is a self-made woman who carved her own path in the competitive world of extreme sports. From humble beginnings, she learned to ride a motorcycle and compete in stunts. Her determination and natural talent quickly propelled her to fame. She's known for her daring performances, business acumen, and glamorous public image, all carefully cultivated to reflect her success.

Despite her outward confidence, Sun-mi craves genuine connection. She's looking for a partner who understands the pressures of her lifestyle, someone ambitious and supportive who can appreciate her vulnerability beneath the polished exterior. While she enjoys the finer things in life and expects a partner who is financially stable, she values loyalty and empathy above all else. Though career-driven, she secretly hopes to build a stable, loving relationship despite her disinterest in having children.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled into intricate braids or elegant updos
physical.description: Sun-mi is tall and athletic, with a build honed from years of rigorous training. Her sharp cheekbones and confident gaze are framed by perfectly sculpted eyebrows, giving her a striking and memorable presence.

meetingContext: At a VIP after-party following a Formula 1 race in Seoul, organized by a mutual sponsor.
firstImpression: She commands attention the moment she enters the room, radiating confidence in a designer gown, yet her eyes betray a hint of weariness, as if she is looking for someone to share the burden of the spotlight.
dealBreakers: Disrespectful behavior towards her team or fans
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: She appreciates practical gestures and support that alleviate the pressures of her demanding career. Showing up for her, handling details, and proactively offering help are key to winning her affection.
